atoms.text: Khalid and the twins, Aylin and Lena, want to throw their paper planes to see who could throw their plane the longest distance. Let’s help them!

instruction.text: Sort the paper planes in order from long, to longer, to longest. Start with the longest paper plane at the top.

trainers.finishSound: The yellow paper plane is long, the green paper plane is longer, and the blue paper plane is longest.

cards.text: The blue paper plane flew the longest distance.
cards.sound: The blue paper plane flew the longest distance.

cards.text: The green paper plane flew the longest distance.
cards.sound: The green paper plane flew the longest distance.

cards.text: The yellow paper plane flew the same distance as the green one.

cards.text: The yellow paper plane flew a longer distance than the green one.

atoms.text: Lena threw her paper plane the longest distance! Aylin and Khalid threw their paper planes the same distance, so they want to throw them again. But this time they want to measure the distance they throw their paper planes. Let’s go!

instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct phrase.

atoms.sound: ssml: Khalid threw his paper plane, <break time='500ms'/>blank<break time='500ms'/>, Aylin threw hers.
atoms.b: Khalid threw his paper plane ((++a_longer_distance_than --the_same_distance_as --a_shorter_distance_than)) Aylin threw hers.
atoms.finishSound: Khalid threw his paper plane a longer distance than Aylin threw hers.

instruction.text: Who threw their paper plane the longer distance? Drag the correct symbol into the orange box.

end.text: Well done! 5 m is greater than 3 m.
